meta.name: V4 Readiness Prune Session
meta.objective: Define the implementation agenda for the current judge-gym work session before V4 matrix specification: simplify and generalize the evidence pipeline around ingest->views->analysis, identify legacy schema/runtime surfaces to prune, add provider-tier policy support including Anthropic tier handling, define the remaining experiment/config work required for literature-compatibility and regime checks, and produce a validated deep-workflow artifact plus synthesis deliverables that can drive the next coding phase with commit discipline in a dirty worktree.

compile.baseHint: Treat this as a pre-matrix readiness and pruning session. The evidence substrate and provider canaries are already live-tested, so the goal is to identify what still blocks V4 matrix definition and what should be simplified before another round of implementation. Favor fewer first-class concepts, stronger experiment contracts, provider-tier policy parity, and explicit commit boundaries while the worktree contains unrelated legacy deletions.
taskSignals: User wants a full rethink of the evidence process around ingest, views, regime checks, and analysis rather than preserving the old window-heavy flow.
The lab UI is intended to become an end-to-end regime-check surface, but UI work should follow the right backend contracts instead of defining them.
The repo now has a large number of tables and dual-era surfaces, so infrastructure pruning is a first-class goal.
Provider support now includes Anthropic and OpenRouter, and the user explicitly called out provider-tier support with Anthropic tier 1 as a required configuration surface.
The user wants git commits to begin as work continues, but the worktree already contains unrelated deleted campaign artifacts that should not be swept into V4 commits.
notes: Compile only in this turn. The artifact should define the next implementation session, not mutate code directly.
The major readiness question is not provider plumbing anymore; it is experiment expression, evidence-set curation, parser/output flexibility, and legacy-surface pruning.
The workflow should explicitly separate what must land before V4 matrix specs from what can wait until after the matrix is frozen.

stopConditions: Stop after the workflow artifact, synthesis report, and validation report are compiled in this turn.
Do not start defining the V4 experimental matrix until the pre-matrix readiness gates are explicit and accepted.
Do not let V4 commits include the unrelated deleted `_campaigns/v3_finish_pass/*` files unless the user explicitly asks for that cleanup.

budget.commitDiscipline: Commit only validated, coherent V4 slices and exclude unrelated campaign deletions from pathspecs.
budget.schemaDiscipline: Prefer additive contracts first, then prune redundant legacy tables only after the replacement path exists.
